title: Paloma Faith: As I Am
overview: Paloma Faith exploded onto the music scene in 2009 with her debut album, which went platinum within weeks. She quickly became a household name, known for her retro-soul sound and her dramatic aesthetic, with appearances as a judge on ‘The Voice’ and in numerous TV series. In her decade-long career, she has headlined at Glastonbury, had multi-million album sales and topped the music charts across the world.  This observational documentary is an intimate look at one of the most turbulent moments in her career so far - touring as a new mother.
